title: feat(approvals): the approval request page shows the whole business record
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBCAJcTbxAnnc3gf8ESZGP1U)_

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzhGHzMtixGDQoMmtqq

Fixes #34588

Clause-②: yes (widening — new @object-ui/i18n locale keys only; no metadata or schema accept set)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么：审批请求页去掉「详情 / 时间线」两个标签页。审批按钮下面直接显示整条业务记录，分组和对象的默认记录页一致；下面是只读子表；右栏依次是审批进度、附件、动态，动态在最后。
- 为什么改：以前只显示金额加 6 个字段，审批人要跳到业务记录才能看全（维护者 2026-11-17：「审批页应该直接显示完整的记录；「动态」在最后」）。
- 风险与回滚：只改前端展示和请求页的页面元数据，不改快照存储和字段权限，审批页上不能编辑。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。改动 3463 行，超过 3000 行门槛，属于 Tier H。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/approval-decision/SubmittedRecord.tsx` 的文件头（规则），再看 `ApprovalDecisionPanel.tsx` 的布局。
- 两分钟验证：打开一条待审批的请求，确认整条记录都在。到业务记录上改一个字段后刷新，该字段应显示「已改动」和当前值。右栏顺序应是审批进度、附件、动态。
- 需要你做的：审一下，因为是 Tier H，需要 os-zhuang 或 hotlong 批准后才能合并。

## What changes

**The request page** (`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/sys-approval-request.page.ts`): `page:header` → `record:highlights` → `record:approval_decision`, with no `page:tabs`. The Details tab (the request's own fields) and the Timeline tab (the `sys_approval_action` related list) are gone. Their content is now inside the decision panel. No node type or prop was added: `record:approval_decision` keeps its empty strict props row, so every part of the layout lives in the panel.

**The decision panel** (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/approval-decision/`):

- **Top:** the "Flow-initiated" marker, the deciding comment, and the declared decision actions. All unchanged. #34361 ruling A is not touched.
- **Left column, "As submitted"** (`SubmittedRecord.tsx` + pure `submittedRecordPlan.ts`):
  - Every field of the request's `payload` snapshot that the reader may read, in the sections of the target object's default record page (`deriveRecordDetailSections` with field groups resolved), each through the record page's own cell, with `payload_display` names for references.
  - Not drawn: undeclared keys, `hidden: true` fields, framework columns, and fields the reader may not read. Field-level security is unchanged. The service redacts per reader, and both rows also pass `withoutDeniedFields`.
  - One `findOne(object, id)` (no params) reads the current record. A field whose current value differs is marked **Changed** (已改动) with its current value. `valuesDiffer` treats empty values as equivalent, numbers by value, dates by instant, references by id (stored or expanded), and lists as sets.
  - If the record cannot be read (refused, gone, not found), nothing is marked and the card says so.
  - "Open record" links to the business record.
- **Child tables:** owned `master_detail` children and `relatedList: 'primary'` tables (`deriveRelatedLists`), each a plugin-detail `RelatedList` with no New, Add, edit or row action. They show CURRENT rows, with a note saying so, because the snapshot keeps the record's own row only. They are drawn only once the record reads.
- **Right rail, in this order:**
  - Approval progress: the step line, the tally, and who it waits on.
  - Attachments: the record's file and image fields.
  - Activity: the request's thread, newest first, through the new `approval-progress/ApprovalActionTimeline.tsx`, which `RecordApprovalsPanel` now shares, so the two timelines cannot drift.
  - The thread is read through the page's adapter (`useRecordContext().dataSource`, which the console routes to `GET /approvals/requests/:id/actions`). It is read only on a read verdict for `sys_approval_action`, as the Timeline related list was.
- **Retired:** `RecordSnapshotSummary.tsx`, `snapshotSummaryPlan.ts` and its test (the six-row cut and the amount lead).

**Copy:** seven new `approvalsInbox.*` keys in all eleven `@object-ui/i18n` packs: `snapshotChanged`, `snapshotCurrentValue`, `snapshotOpenRecord`, `snapshotCurrentUnreadable`, `snapshotChildCurrent`, `progressTitle`, `attachmentsTitle`.

**Why this route, not embedding the business record page:** the record page is a live, editable surface with its own approval bar (#34361) and header actions. Embedding it would put editing and a second decision bar on the request page, and it would show current values, not the evidence the approver is asked to decide on. The snapshot-faithful card keeps the submitted values primary and marks the drift. The seat accepted this route on the card thread.

**Not done (card 不做):** no editing; no change to snapshot storage. Child tables show current values, marked as such.

## Tests

- New `submittedRecordPlan.test.ts` (plan and comparison rules) and `ApprovalDecisionPanel.fullRecord-34588.test.tsx`. The second covers acceptance 1–3 on a 14-field record with groups, a denied field, a `master_detail` child, a changed field, rail order, child tables read-only, the `findOne` call shape, and an unreadable CONTROL.
- Updated app-shell pins: `ApprovalDecisionPanel.test.tsx` (directory-read counts now exclude the one thread read; the pending CONTROL expects that read), `ApprovalDecisionPanel.stepLine-12491.test.tsx` (decisions on top, then line above tally inside the progress card), and `ApprovalDecisionPanel.decidedSnapshot-27502.test.tsx` (testids). `RecordApprovalsPanel` tests are unchanged and green.
- `sys-approval-request-page.test.ts`: the body order is header, highlights, decision, with a new "has no tabs" test. The step_label timeline-column test is retired along with the tab.

### Console pins rewritten (seat-widened surface: `approvalRequestsDataSource.servedPage*.test.tsx`)

The "Card line" column cites the card's 要做的 items. Item 1 is 「请求页在审批条下方直接显示该业务记录的完整内容：全部可读字段按对象的分组排列、子表（相关列表，只读）、附件」. Item 2 is 「提交后被改过的字段在旁边标出「已改动」并能看到当前值」. Item 4 is 「字段级权限照旧」.

`approvalRequestsDataSource.servedPageSummary-12483.test.tsx`

| Pin | Old assertion | New assertion | Card line |
|---|---|---|---|
| served page shape | `components[1]` is `record:approval_decision` (page with tabs) | the last component is `record:approval_decision`; no `page:tabs` | 1, 3 and the ruling 「「动态」在最后」 |
| labels and faces | the unresolved reference `contact` takes no row, and its raw id is never printed | `contact` is drawn as the record page draws it (the lookup cell's unresolved-reference face) | 1 (all readable fields) |
| amount | the amount leads (`[data-summary-lead]`) and is not repeated as a row | no lead; `amount` is an ordinary field, drawn once, through the currency face | 1 |
| hidden field | rows are exactly the six: `name, account, cost_center, region, status, issued_on` | rows are all ten declared visible fields; `internal_score` stays out | 1 (not only 6) |
| COUNTER-PROBE nothing hidden | `internal_score` drawn and the last row is cut | `internal_score` drawn, nothing cut (11 rows) | 1 |
| hidden amount | never leads, shown nowhere | shown nowhere (no lead exists) | 1 |
| field permissions | denied fields' slots go to the next fields (six rows) | the full list minus `cost_center` and `amount`; neither value anywhere | 1, 4 |
| COUNTER-PROBE allowed | `lead.key === 'amount'` | `amount` is drawn | 1 |
| no read of the record | no read beyond the approvals get; no `invoice` path on the transport | one `host.findOne('invoice', 'inv_1')`, no params; `amount` marked Changed with its current value; an expanded same-id account is not a change; still no `invoice` path on the transport | 2 |
| new CONTROL | — | a record that does not read: the unreadable note, nothing marked, all ten fields drawn | 2 |
| CONTROL no payload | waits for the definition read of `invoice`, no summary | no record card; neither the definition nor the record is asked for | 1 (nothing to draw without a snapshot) |
| CONTROLs: undeclared key, label clash, no definition | `record-snapshot-summary` testid | `submitted-record` testid, same assertions | 1 |
| roll-up name guess | no lead; `total_amount` a row inside the six (cost center removed to make room) | no lead; `total_amount` an ordinary field (no row cut, so cost center stays) | 1 |
| amount of zero | zero leads | zero is drawn as the `amount` field | 1 |

`approvalRequestsDataSource.servedPageSummaryAmount-12534.test.tsx`: the whole file pinned which roll-up takes the lead. With no lead, every row below is retired by item 1.

| Pin | Old assertion | New assertion |
|---|---|---|
| expense total | `total_amount` leads; the rows are six without it | `total_amount` is an ordinary field; all ten fields, `sum` and `count` roll-ups alike, in declared order |
| invoice subtotal | `total` leads | `total` is an ordinary field |
| definition read | the summarized object's definition is read once; no record read | the summarized object's definition is never read (the record read is pinned in 12483) |
| FLS | without `total_amount`, `approved_amount` leads | `total_amount` is not drawn; `approved_amount` still is |
| CONTROL non-`sum` | no lead; `line_count` a row | folded into the expense-total test (`line_count` row) |
| CONTROL `sum` over `number` | no lead | retired: no lead logic is left to control |
| CONTROL currency-only | `unit_price` leads | `unit_price` is an ordinary field |
| CONTROL child definition unreadable | the total is an ordinary row | retired: the total is always an ordinary row |
| new | — | the record's child lines: once the record reads, `showcase_expense_line` is drawn read-only, with the current-rows note and its rows |
| new CONTROL | — | a record that does not read draws no child lines and sends no child read |

Not edited, and green: `approvalRequestsDataSource.decisionPage.test.tsx` (including :341, where the timeline reads the actions route and never `host.find`) and `approvalRequestsDataSource.servedPageMemberPermissions-13324.test.tsx` (including the no-`ApprovalRecordReads` control, which sends no actions GET). Both were red mid-change. The cause was fixed in source, not in the pins: the thread read now goes through the page's adapter and is gated on the read verdict.

## Acceptance notes

1. Full record below the approval bar: every readable field, grouped like the default record page; child tables read-only; attachments. ✓ (`fullRecord-34588` acceptance 1, console 12483/12534.)
2. Snapshot values, with fields changed after submission marked 「已改动」 and showing their current value. ✓ (`fullRecord-34588` acceptance 2, console 12483 "read once".)
3. Right rail: 审批进度 → 附件 → 动态. ✓ (`fullRecord-34588` rail order.)
4. Field-level security unchanged. ✓ (denied-field tests in both suites.)

## Verification

Run on this head (9f91de6c; the tree is identical to the gated working tree):

- `pnpm exec vitest run apps/console/src/services/approvalRequestsDataSource apps/console/src/pages/system/ApprovalsInboxPage` (from `ui/`): 31 files, 219/219 pass, exit 0.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/approval-decision packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordApprovalsPanel` (from `ui/`): 16 files, 116/116 pass, exit 0.
- `vitest run` on `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/sys-approval-request-page.test.ts` and `sys-approval-request-title.integration.test.ts`: 24/24 pass, exit 0.
- `tsc --noEmit`: `@object-ui/app-shell` exit 0, `@object-ui/i18n` exit 0, `@objectstack/plugin-approvals` exit 0.
- `eslint` on the changed ui files: exit 0, with 0 errors and 7 warnings. The warnings are in moved code: `no-explicit-any` on `import.meta`, and react-refresh on a hook export.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs`: VERDICT clean (merges cleanly with origin/main, #34624 and #34628), exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs --changed-from origin/main`: exit 0.
- The `dispatch-gates --commands` battery (72 commands) runs under the verify lock. Its exit codes, reconciled with `--ran`, are posted in the os-dev-report comment on #34588.

## Before / after readings

- **Before** (origin/main 8dd8192c): the request page has `page:tabs` (Details, Timeline). The decision panel draws "As submitted" with the amount lead and at most six rows (12483: rows `name, account, cost_center, region, status, issued_on`), and never reads the target record.
- **After** (this head): no tabs. 12483 draws all ten visible fields, with `contact` through the lookup face. One `findOne('invoice','inv_1')`, and a changed `amount` carries the Changed mark with its current value (13,250) beside the submitted 12,500. 12534 draws the `showcase_expense_line` child table read-only from current rows. The rail order is progress, attachments, activity (`fullRecord-34588`).
